'''Vaxan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] who worked in the [[Yarith Bespin/Legends|Yarith Bespin]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]], in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. He failed to turn up for work one day, causing the casino's [[Droid/Legends|droid]] dealers to become worried about what had happened to him.
